name: *Hyun-ae
source:
An AI on the Mugunghwa. A helpful girl with a romantic mindset who also enjoys cosplay. She does have her own secrets though.

[spoiler]
Her real name is Kim Hyun-Ae, also called the Pale Bride.

She was a girl who downloaded her mind into a computer (nearly killing *Mute) to avoid her complete death when she completely wiped out the entire population of the Mugunghwa in an act of revenge. She was a very sick girl in life so her father put her into stasis until a future where she could be treated was made. It didn't work out.[/spoiler]
